answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in canyon, expire in zenith, and raven lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 109 aliases as a result needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 109 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
